Select compounds with IC50 measurements in nM against human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs via activities.doc_id to obtain pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_records via activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name for human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic and activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
